patches.value: For every metric space X, A⊆X and real q>0, if μH[q](A)=0 then μH[q+1](A×I)=0 in maxProd(X,ℝ). Under the same premise μH[q](A)=0, more precisely, for every 0<r≤1 and ε>0 there is a countable cover of A×I of diameter at most 2r and total (q+1)-cost <2^(q+2)ε (hence also ≤ that bound). The constant depends only on q.

For a metric (or extended metric) space Z, real p, r∈[0,∞], B⊆Z, define C_p(r,B)=inf_{U:ℕ→Set Z} inf_{B⊆⋃i U_i} inf_{∀i ediam(U_i)≤r} ∑_{i≥0} sup_{h:U_i≠∅}(ediam(U_i))^p. Empty infima are ∞ and empty suprema are 0. Thus empty cover members cost zero, also at p=0. This is exactly YuiContent in basis-registry.json/lean_header. For a real scale δ≥0, C_p(δ,B) means C_p(ofReal δ,B); nonnegative real finite costs are embedded in [0,∞]. Throughout, a δ-cover means a family covering the set with ediam of every member ≤ofReal δ; the finite-scale real-diameter notation never admits an unbounded member through toReal(∞)=0.
